lines_of_business: BCBSM and BCN commercial; Medicare Advantage may use the policy when CMS rules are not fully developed (42 CFR § 422.101(b)(6)); BCN benefit page at end
sections_in_order: Government Regulations (National, Local LCD L39051, Article A58774)
criteria_location: Inclusionary and Exclusionary Guidelines, p.1-2 (two ALL-of paths joined by OR); Medicare LCD criteria are restated in Government Regulations pp.3-5 and are different (3 months, 6 months stable, 18 months post-bariatric).

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Panniculectomy when the above criteria are not met' only; LCD text lists non-covered (diastasis recti, solely to improve appearance, hernia prevention).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The panniculus causes uncontrolled intertrigo (which is unresponsive to conservative therapy including topical drying agents, corticosteroids and appropriate antibiotics/antifungals), skin ulceration, or other skin changes such as skin necrosis or peau d'orange.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'unresponsive to conservative therapy' modifies intertrigo only or all three conditions? No duration given.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: This procedure may also be medically necessary for the individual who has had a significant weight-loss ... in addition to meeting the criteria noted above
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: In the LCD section (not the commercial criteria) 'in addition to'; commercial criteria and LCD criteria differ and the document does not say which governs which line.

requirement_kinds.quote: A panniculus that hangs below the level of the pubis
uncontrolled intertrigo ... skin ulceration, or other skin changes such as skin necrosis or peau d'orange
unresponsive to conservative therapy including topical drying agents, corticosteroids and appropriate antibiotics/antifungals
Documented massive weight loss of at least 100 pounds as a result of bariatric surgery or dieting
Sufficient time has elapsed (a minimum of 6 months) to ensure maximum weight loss and weight stability
Preoperative photographs may be required to support justification and should be supplied upon request
Difficulty walking or functional impairment in activities of daily living due to pannus size, chronic pain, and/or ulceration

thresholds.quote: stable weight for at least 6 months
until at least 18 months after bariatric surgery

time_windows.what: Time elapsed after massive weight loss

time_windows.quote: stable weight for at least 6 months
not be performed until at least 18 months after bariatric surgery

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: 15830 only; 'inclusion of a code in this list is not a guarantee of coverage'

external_dependencies.what: Medicare LCD L39051 and Article A58774
external_dependencies.quote: Local Coverage Determination (LCD) for Cosmetic and Reconstructive Surgery (L39051)

external_dependencies.what: Related policies Bariatric Surgery, Cosmetic and Reconstructive Surgery
CMS Benefit Policy Manual Ch.16 s120 for cosmetic definition
external_dependencies.quote: CMS IOM Publication 100-02, Medicare Benefit Policy Manual, Chapter 16: Section 120

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: dermatitis occurring on opposed surfaces of the skin, skin irritation, infection or chafing that consistently recurs or remains refractory

vague_terms.quote: hangs below the level of the pubis
vague_terms.problem: landmark, not graded; photos not required in commercial section

extraction_hazards: Medicare LCD criteria (different thresholds) share the document with commercial criteria
Page numbers and headers inside lists
Criteria include sub-bullet 'o' with 'and' tokens at line ends
BCN benefit page appended with administrative rules not clinical
interesting_structures: Two OR'd pathways: post-weight-loss and non-weight-loss
Short: no functional-impairment or ADL requirement in commercial criteria
LCD text embedded as reference with stricter timing

fit_to_tree.why: Short and cleanly any-of-two, each all-of; only the embedded LCD and vague 'uncontrolled' need care.
